_note: version, anchor and why are notes for humans - nothing executes them. paths/run/always/default/unmapped drive the Stop gate; agents drives /crew:review; environments drives /crew:promote.

rules.why: Go build, vet, gofmt and every package's tests. The swap path handles live Claude credentials, so a security read rides along on source changes. reach: local - compiles and tests on disk; no network, no live credentials.
a syntax error in a harness script makes every gate report a failure that is not in the code. reach: local - bash -n parses only.

bash -n parses install-agent.sh, then the stub case runs it against fake agent/systemctl binaries in a throwaway HOME (36 checks, exit 77 = skipped). NOT covered: scripts/install-agent.ps1 has no automated check (no PowerShell parse step in this gate; Windows install is verified by hand per docs/runbooks). reach: local - no network, no live host, nothing outside a temp dir is touched.

.gitattributes pins *.go and *.sh to LF so CRLF checkouts do not break gofmt or bash. The script fails when git check-attr no longer reports eol=lf for them, or gofmt -l cmd internal prints anything. reach: local - reads git attributes and source on disk.

documentation, agent instructions, crew config and graph output. Listed so it does not trip unmapped:fail - deliberately unchecked, not forgotten. seconds/reach are declared only because the qa audit (G1) wants every rule to carry them; an empty run never executes.
AGENTS.md is generated from these files; --check fails when it no longer matches them. Regenerate: python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/scripts/crew_instructions.py" agents --root .

development.rollbackReason: no rollback runbook exists yet (owner decision 2026-11-04); development is this LAN host running go run ./cmd/server from the checkout, so reverting means checking out the previous sha. Write docs/runbooks/rollback.md before declaring qa or production.
